card.name: Punctuation before sleep-related terms
card.fires_on: Commas, 'including', 'and' or an opening parenthesis right after a sleep-disorder heading or phrase, where another sleep-related term comes next (sleepwalking, hallucinations, apnea).

modes.label: Comma after sleep paralysis
modes.description: Comma following 'Sleep Paralysis' in warning headings, before hypnagogic hallucinations.

modes.label: Linking word in complex sleep behaviors
modes.description: 'including' or a comma after 'complex sleep behaviors', before sleepwalking or sleep-driving.
modes.example: WARNING: COMPLEX SLEEP BEHAVIORS Complex sleep behaviors<< including>> sleep-walking, sleep-driving, and

modes.label: Bracket before sleep study term
modes.description: Opening parenthesis after polysomnographic evaluation, before the abbreviation PSG and sleep apnea.
modes.example: During polysomnographic evaluation<< (>>PSG), central sleep apnea and

card.plain: It fires on the small punctuation or linking word that comes just before another sleep-related term in a warnings list.
